title: Correct decoding of the algorithm output
statement: Let an input type and a packed-assignment type have binary encodings, each with decoding inverse to encoding and with every successfully decoded string equal to the canonical encoding of its decoded object. Let a conditional-expectation adapter consist of an algorithm on binary strings and a semantic map from encoded inputs to finite randomized CSP inputs, and suppose the algorithm maps each canonically encoded input to the canonical encoding of the packed assignment in its conditional-expectation plan. Then, for every input, decoding the algorithm's output gives exactly that packed assignment.
hypotheses_covered: Binary input and output encodings with the stated inverse properties
Semantic map from encoded inputs to finite randomized CSP inputs
Adapter algorithm has the specified output on every encoded input
